title: A natural sesquiterpene lactone isolinderalactone attenuates lipopolysaccharide-induced inflammatory response and acute lung injury through inhibition of NF-kappaB pathway and activation Nrf2 pathway in macrophages.
authors: Shen, Xiaofei; Chen, Hongqing; Zhang, Hai; Luo, Liuling; Wen, Tian; Liu, Lu; Hu, Qiongying; Wang, Lun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物抑制NF-κB和激活Nrf2通路抗炎，仅涉及分子对接预测小分子与蛋白结合，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Isolinderalactone is the main sesquiterpene lactone isolated from Lindera aggregata, a traditional Chinese medicine widely used to treat pain and inflammation. Although isolinderalactone has been demonstrated to possess anti-cancer effect, its anti-inflammatory activity and underlying mechanism has not been well characterized. Herein, isolinderalactone was able to significantly inhibit the production of NO and PGE(2) by reducing the expressions of iNOS and COX2 in LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages and BMDMs, and decreased the mRNA levels of IL-1beta, IL-6, and TNF-alpha in LPS-induced RAW264.7 cells. In vivo, isolinderalactone effectively alleviated LPS-induced acute lung injury (ALI), which manifested as reduction in pulmonary inflammatory infiltration, myeloperoxidase activity, and production of PGE(2), IL-1beta, IL-6, TNF-alpha, and malondialdehyde. Furthermore, isolinderalactone inhibited phosphorylation of IKKalpha/beta, phosphorylation and degradation of IkappaBalpha, and nuclear translocation of NF-kappaB p65, thereby blocking NF-kappaB pro-inflammatory pathway. Meanwhile, isolinderalactone reduced the intracellular ROS through promoting the activation of Nrf2-HMOX1 antioxidant axis. By using drug affinity responsive target stability assay and molecular docking, isolinderalactone was found to covalently interact with IKKalpha/beta and Keap1, which may contribute to its anti-inflammatory action. Additionally, a thiol donor beta-mercaptoethanol significantly abolished isolinderalactone-mediated anti-inflammatory action in vitro, indicating the crucial role of the unsaturated lactone of isolinderalactone on its anti-inflammatory effects. Taken together, isolinderalactone protected against LPS-induced ALI in mice, which may be associated with its inhibition of NF-kappaB pathway and activation of Nrf2 signaling in macrophages.
abstract_zh: Isolinderalactone是从传统中药乌药（Lindera aggregata）中分离得到的主要倍半萜内酯，该中药广泛用于治疗疼痛和炎症。尽管已证明isolinderalactone具有抗癌作用，但其抗炎活性及潜在机制尚未得到充分表征。本研究中，isolinderalactone能够通过降低LPS刺激的RAW264.7巨噬细胞和BMDMs中iNOS和COX2的表达，显著抑制NO和PGE(2)的产生，并降低LPS诱导的RAW264.7细胞中IL-1beta、IL-6和TNF-alpha的mRNA水平。在体内实验中，isolonderalactone有效缓解了LPS诱导的急性肺损伤（ALI），表现为肺部炎症浸润、髓过氧化物酶活性以及PGE(2)、IL-1beta、IL-6、TNF-alpha和丙二醛产生的减少。此外，isolinderalactone抑制了IKKalpha/beta的磷酸化、IkappaBalpha的磷酸化和降解，以及NF-kappaB p65的核转位，从而阻断NF-kappaB促炎通路。同时，isolinderalactone通过促进Nrf2-HMOX1抗氧化轴的激活，降低了细胞内ROS水平。利用药物亲和响应靶标稳定性分析和分子对接，发现isolinderalactone与IKKalpha/beta和Keap1发生共价相互作用，这可能有助于其抗炎作用。此外，硫醇供体β-巯基乙醇在体外显著消除了isolinderalactone介导的抗炎作用，表明isolinderalactone的不饱和内酯对其抗炎效果至关重要。综上所述，isolinderalactone保护小鼠免受LPS诱导的ALI，这可能与其抑制巨噬细胞中NF-kappaB通路和激活Nrf2信号有关。
